queue.title: Gender Selection Screen
queue.description: Gender selection with quick options and expanded modal for more choices
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar (40%)
Header: 'What's your gender?'
3 large buttons: Man, Woman, More →
Privacy toggle (checkbox): 'Show my gender on my profile' (default OFF)
Next button (disabled until selection made)
More button opens full-screen modal with title 'Select one that best represents you'
Modal has 10+ options: Man, Woman, Trans Man, Trans Woman, Non-binary, Agender, Genderfluid, Genderqueer, Two-Spirit, Other
Modal has search bar (can be non-functional placeholder for now)
Single selection (radio button behavior)
Privacy toggle persists across modal open/close
queue.safetyNotes: Pure UI work, hardcoded options (no database yet), no complex logic

inProgress.title: Community Guidelines Screen
inProgress.description: Create welcome screen after phone verification showing community rules that user must accept
acceptanceCriteria: Header: 'Welcome to DejTing. Please follow these House Rules.'
4 rules with checkmark icons: Be yourself, Stay safe, Play it cool, Be proactive
Large white 'I agree' button at bottom
Bilingual content (English only for MVP, Swedish later)
Back navigation NOT allowed (user must accept to proceed)
Store acceptance in local state (backend integration later)
inProgress.safetyNotes: Pure UI work, no external services, no auth logic

completed.title: First Name Entry Screen
completed.description: Single-field wizard screen for user to enter their first name with validation
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar at top (20% filled, coral gradient)
Header: 'What's your first name?'
Single text input field (auto-focused)
Warning text: 'This is how it'll appear on your profile. Can't change it later.'
Next button (disabled until valid input, coral color when enabled)
Validation: Min 2 chars, max 50 chars, letters/spaces/hyphens/apostrophes only
Auto-capitalize first letter
Trim whitespace
Back arrow (go to previous screen) + close X (exit wizard)
completed.safetyNotes: Simple text validation, no backend calls, no sensitive data

completed.title: Birthday Entry Screen
completed.description: Date input screen with three separate fields (month, day, year) and 18+ validation
acceptanceCriteria: Progress bar (30%)
Header: 'Your b-day?'
Three separate inputs: Month (dropdown 1-12), Day (input 1-31), Year (input 1900-2008)
Privacy note: 'Your profile shows your age, not your birthdate'
Real date validation (Feb 30 = error, leap years handled)
Calculate age from date, must be >= 18
Next button (disabled until valid date AND 18+)
Under-18 error modal: 'You must be 18 or older to use this app' with 'Go back' button
Can't select future dates
completed.safetyNotes: Date math only, no user data storage, straightforward validation
